description: Declarative capture of the two [FIXED] fault matrices. Row text is quoted verbatim from the spec. These are not v1 material — they are v2-spec obligations captured now so their shape is fixed; the executable failpoint/kill-point scripts are a registered gap (GAP-06).

matrices.name: Projection fault-detection matrix
matrices.property: Every case leads to detection at open -> dirty -> rebuild. Proves (a) any divergence is detected at open; (b) rebuild is correct and idempotent.
matrices.gap: Executable fail_point!-style scripts authored in T00-03 (harness) and T07-05 (F1-F12 fault matrix); absent in v1.

rows.injected_fault: kill between write-ahead and first backend op
kill mid-upsert batch
kill after all point ops, before write_head
kill after write_head, before SQLite commit
shard WAL loss/truncation after clean commit
partial point deletion with intact catalog
missing head / stale head from previous op
equal point_count, different ID set
failed final upsert/delete reported as ok by backend
backend flush/sync failure swallowed
rows.expected_signal: same as F5 at next open

rows.injected_fault: crash during rebuild
corruption making shard unopenable

matrices.name: Spool kill matrix
matrices.property: No event with stable identity is ever lost after spool append (S8 [FIXED gate]); import is idempotent under daemon/hook kill at any point.
matrices.gap: Executable kill-point scripts authored in T00-03 (harness) and T13-06 (S1-S8 kill matrix); absent in v1.

rows.injected_fault: hook killed mid-write (torn frame)
rows.expected_signal: event not durable; importer ignores tail; next hook appends after flock — segment remains valid

rows.injected_fault: hook killed after fdatasync, before exit
daemon killed after reading frames, before tx commit
rows.expected_signal: cursor not advanced; re-import; UNIQUE/dedup window prevents duplicates

rows.injected_fault: daemon killed after tx commit, before segment truncation
daemon killed mid-truncation/rotation
duplicate stable event across segments (hook retry)
duplicate best-effort event within window
rows.expected_signal: one envelope (windowed dedup); outside window: two envelopes, consolidation idempotence still holds

rows.injected_fault: crash at any point
rows.expected_signal: no event with stable identity is ever lost after spool append [FIXED gate]
